sourceIdentity: The image basis is the normalized output of the actual complete original T96 graph. The full graph proves each G row lies in im(R), and its distinct-head degree sum716 proves it spans im(R). Every quotient and complete remainder is saved. G*Q+remainder=RHS is accumulated independently in all1034 components and all9 RHS. The RHS is the actual saved normal form of (H0*T-A*X)/961 modulo31, obtained from the original integer model modulo29791 and the actual primitive source X modulo961. An all-zero remainder pays membership in the full F31[s] R image only. Kernel freedom and the original6188-row correction modulo29791 are separate stages.
